games.name: Bayonetta PC
games.format: Opaque system-data candidates; authoritative keyboard-binding storage/decoder unresolved
limitations: Firsthand reports disagree about which copy stores which settings. Documents system_data may chiefly contain graphics settings; resetting it did not consistently reset keybindings.
No verified current binary schema or keybinding record layout. No replacement file or repair of the invalid Azeron ZIP is attempted.
V3 gameplay and menus are separate; Punch/Kick and weapon scrolling remain mouse-owned.

games.name: BioShock 2 Remastered
games.format: INI key-to-command mappings, with multiple sections/contexts
limitations: Map the actual command strings and their aliases, including contextual Use/Interact. Preserve mouse keys and all unrelated INI lines.
The V3 Exit Scout Mode -> Tab placement needs a console/context collision audit on the installed build.

games.name: BioShock Infinite
games.format: XUserOptions.ini contains an encoded UserKeyMappings value, not a simple action table
limitations: A firsthand edit-and-diff investigation identifies UserKeyMappings as an encoded blob. Ordinary Unreal Bindings lines are not an established substitute.
The 20 requested assignments remain a source-derived plan; all other preferences and the mouse controls must remain intact.

games.name: BioShock Remastered
limitations: Preserve section-specific commands, mouse fire/mode switching/scrolling and non-binding preferences.
The planner partly cites a Mac-port manual. The actual Windows file must establish command identifiers and available actions.

games.name: Control
limitations: A binary preferences file is not renderer.ini. Renderer settings must not be fabricated as keyboard bindings.
The current keyboard-record schema and any integrity fields remain unresolved. Microsoft Store/WGS variants are not assigned an invented container filename.
V3 Switch Weapon shares a documented context/hold relationship with Use/Seize; the actual file must establish whether the bindings are separable.

games.name: Cyberpunk 2077
games.format: JSON user-setting entries with IK_* keycodes; XML mapping/context definitions
limitations: V3 specifies 28 placements but defers 30 contextual actions. Call vehicle, vehicle controls and braindance functions cannot be moved by a global text replacement.
The retained evidence distinguishes right Ctrl/Shift hold bindings from left Ctrl/Shift dash/toggle bindings. The generic planner labels do not prove they are the same physical key.
Preserve graphics hotkeys and CET/UltraPlus/ReShade settings. Existing input mods may redirect the effective XML, so their files must be audited without enabling or replacing mods.

games.name: Devil May Cry 5
games.format: dmc5config.ini exists, but keyboard-binding ownership and system-save record schema are not established
limitations: Capcom identifies the configuration and save directory, but does not identify an editable keyboard section in the cited FAQ.
No invented [KEYBOARD] section and no borrowed system-save offsets. The exact storage/record format remains a blocker even after the initial inspection samples.
All three source characters (Nero, Dante, V) are included. The planner contains no Vergil V3 variant.

games.name: DOOM The Dark Ages
games.format: Native .cfg / .local settings; installed action identifiers and bind-set ownership require inspection
limitations: Do not borrow DOOM Eternal impulse numbers or assume the local renderer/cvar file is a complete binding map.
Confirm Slayer, Atlan and dragon/context action ownership where the source labels involve those actions. Preserve renderer, HDR, DLSS, performance and all unrelated settings.
The project records the game as previously uninstalled and a graphics experiment as paused; this package does not reinstall or resume it.

games.name: God of War Ragnarok
games.format: Extensionless userpreferences container; keyboard schema not verified
limitations: The Unicode ö in the folder name matters. The collector also checks the plain-o spelling as a fallback candidate and labels it as such.
The current keyboard-record representation and integrity rules have not been verified; no fabricated INI/JSON is supplied.
No PSN-related mod, bypass or preference reset is part of this work.

games.name: GTA V Enhanced
games.format: XML control mappings with action, source-device and parameter entries; sparse overrides
limitations: Use Enhanced, not a Legacy GTA V configuration. Firsthand XML examples identify Input/Source/Parameters and KEY_* keyboard tokens.
Mouse/wheel XML records must remain byte-preserved. A sparse override cannot safely be replaced by an invented full default table.
Reconcile on-foot, vehicle and menu contexts and the V3 camera binding against the installed build.

games.name: Hogwarts Legacy
games.format: Unreal-style Input.ini ActionMappings, with modifier flags and game-specific fields
limitations: Action names, groups and the existing press/hold/chord configuration must come from this file/build, not from another Unreal game.
Preserve controller/mouse mappings and all non-target lines. Treat mod-added and Photo Mode controls as version-dependent.
All 41 source placements are extracted, including secondary spell/panel and contextual placements.

games.name: Middle-earth Shadow of War
games.format: Native keyboard-binding file/decoder not verified; known .cfg files are graphics-related
limitations: A firsthand investigation found graphics.cfg and render.cfg but did not establish a keyboard-binding file. Its suggestion that saves own bindings remains speculation.
V3 Map: M -> N is additionally unresolved because users report that map cannot be rebound through the normal controls menu.
No external remapper or device-output change is substituted for an unsupported native mapping.

games.name: NieR Automata
games.format: Per-slot binary saves contain a binding block in a documented older implementation; global SystemData is separate
limitations: A published save-tool implementation locates a binding block in SlotData. Its old offsets/lengths are evidence of storage, not authorization to patch a current save at assumed offsets.
Current slot layout, key-code representation and integrity checks must be verified. Steam/account identity and progression must remain untouched.
V3 explicitly defers Fire, Light Attack and Heavy Attack for mouse-ownership checking. Those are not missing placements to invent.

games.name: Path of Exile 2
games.format: INI sections ACTION_KEYS and WASD_ACTION_KEYS; numeric key codes and optional modifier fields
limitations: The primary requested SPARSE6 family has 46 placements per preset. GROUPED R2 is retained as a separate alternative with 33 placements per preset and 13 capacity-deferred actions per preset.
Installing both family alternatives into one active game map would conflict. No change to the active movement mode, skill loadout, mouse controls or Azeron profiles is authorized.
Current game field names must confirm new actions such as Market. The 2024 firsthand config dump does not establish every 2026 option.
GROUPED R2 can displace capacity-deferred actions (for example inventory). Those actions cannot silently be cleared.

games.name: Pathfinder Kingmaker
games.format: Unity preferences in Windows Registry; exact binding value types/payload need inspection
limitations: A native keybinding file analogous to Wrath of the Righteous settings.json has not been established for Kingmaker.
A future deliverable should change only verified binding values and preserve value types, unrelated preferences and exact rollback. A whole-branch overwrite is not an acceptable shortcut.
A registry export may contain non-binding preferences; the bundle remains private.

games.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.format: Extensionless KeyMappings file; safe encoding/record round-trip must be established from the original
limitations: The binding-mod author describes editing with a binary editor; ordinary Notepad editing is not established as safe. Do not treat a copied XML-shaped fragment as a valid native replacement.
Confirm record encoding, IDs, duplicated/contextual actions and all relevant on-foot/mounted/vehicle/menu contexts. Preserve L/R mouse and scrolling.
No downloaded third-party complete keymap is substituted for your current settings.

games.name: V Rising
games.format: JSON input settings in a versioned per-user settings directory
limitations: The publisher documents v3; this is not a claim that your currently installed build necessarily still uses v3. The original file and directory evidence determine that.
Do not replace the shipped StreamingAssets settings or server configuration. Preserve existing mouse, alternate mappings and unrelated JSON properties.
